searchText: Eh, I'm a fan of tests breaking ASAP after the spec is upgraded. The longer we wait to update tests to conform to the new spec, the more likely something will get missed/forgotten. If you don't like failing tests, fix your code to match spec. 😄 <@211091239112671234> Will look into it <@!439556036647714817> <@!393119312350543872> I think it's fixed. I copied the files into `testdata/10`, and ran it. Results are in the readme here: https://github.com/holiman/go-ethereum/tree/1559_squashed/cmd/evm/testdata/10 . LMK if it matches your expectations (don't hesitate to file comments on the PR) (now it rejects the last transaction, which it didn't previously) Also, would be good to "somehow" lift these tests into the general tests, see https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3560#issuecomment-835862318 and the comment further down, where I posted some testcases for `gasLimit` and how it may vary from one block to the next. Thank you, it works. I updated the pull request with both gasUsed > gasLimit tests and the sample cases from the geth code.
